description: This file defines a set of metric tags used across the system, including enums for endpoint types, component types, processing outcomes, TTD status, QoS levels, and message directions. It also provides utility methods for creating standard tag sets for protocol adapters and services, as well as specific tags for tenant identification.

classes.name: MetricsTags
classes.description: Contains definitions for metric tags and related enums used for tagging and categorizing metrics in the system.

classes.name: MetricsTags.EndpointType
classes.description: Enumeration of different endpoint types with associated tags and utility methods.

classes.name: MetricsTags.ComponentType
classes.description: Enumeration for component types such as service and adapter, providing associated tags.

classes.name: MetricsTags.ProcessingOutcome
classes.description: Enumeration representing the outcome of message processing, with associated tags.

classes.name: MetricsTags.TtdStatus
classes.description: Enumeration for TTD statuses, with methods for generating tags.

classes.name: MetricsTags.QoS
classes.description: Enumeration for Quality of Service levels, providing methods to generate corresponding tags.

classes.name: MetricsTags.Direction
classes.description: Enumeration for message directions with associated tags.

methods.name: MetricsTags.forProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates default tags for a protocol adapter given its name.

methods.name: MetricsTags.forService
methods.description: Creates default tags for a service given its name.

methods.name: MetricsTags.getTenantTag
methods.description: Creates a tag for a tenant identifier, ensuring the input is non-null.
